name: youtube-video-summarizer-mcp-pydanticai

tools.name: get_video_info
tools.description: Extract comprehensive YouTube video data including metadata, captions/transcripts, and technical details. Returns structured data for intelligent analysis, summarization, or note creation. When captions are available, provides full transcript for content analysis. When unavailable, returns rich metadata for description-based analysis. Use this data to create summaries, identify key points, generate study notes, or assess video accessibility.

videoUrl.description: The URL or ID of the YouTube video

languageCode.description: The language code for captions (optional, e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr')
